status: Actual descriptive re-extraction and arithmetic from published tables; known outcomes disclosed. No new alignments, docking, kinetic fits, or experiments.

computed_rank_inversions.complementing: Dietzia sp. strain Chol2 HisN Dz

hisn.interpretation: Higher overall similarity cannot be used here as a monotonic ordering of complementation support. Motif pattern and measured capacity warrant a different comparator choice.
limits: Four deliberately selected candidates are not a representative classifier benchmark.
Complementation negatives leave expression, folding and host-context alternatives; they are not purified-enzyme nulls.
The subsequent HMM uses these validated proteins as seeds; these same proteins cannot be a held-out validation of that HMM.
No BLAST, pairwise alignment, HMM build or assay was rerun.

tm0936_relatives.source_table: Table 1, PDF page 4, visually checked against local rendered page
tm0936_relatives.units: kcat/Km in M^-1 s^-1; 30 degrees C, pH 7.5
tm0936_relatives.censoring_rule: The published <10 values remain upper limits, never zero or measured values of 10. Ratio bounds assume a positive denominator; a truly zero denominator implies unbounded preference rather than a finite estimate.
tm0936_relatives.interpretation: Arg136-position presence is not sufficient for measurable SAH efficiency in Bc1793; the two template arginines are not necessary for SAH turnover in Tvn0515. These refute those residue-presence rules, not every possible geometric or mechanistic requirement.
limits: All kinetic values and assay outcomes belong to the authors.
Alternative contact and loop explanations are homology-model proposals, not newly measured geometry.
In-vitro substrate preference is distinct from native flux or physiological necessity.
A conserved catalytic core can coexist with different or unidentified substrate profiles.

thought_pattern_candidate.name: Seek cases that separate a proposed predictor from the supported function
decision_branches: If the feature is present but supported function is absent in a controlled comparison, reopen sufficiency and context.
If supported function remains when the proposed feature is absent, reopen necessity and alternative implementations.
If both covary, retain the relationship as a candidate; do not manufacture evidence of necessity or sufficiency.
tool_choices: Published table extraction joined to feature/condition records
Alignment/motif mapping when alignment inputs and validated references are available
Genomic profile comparison with explicit missingness and detection limits
thought_pattern_candidate.compatibility_limit: Complementation negatives, censored kinetic observations, and unassigned genomic-profile cells have different force. The pattern cannot erase those distinctions.
